summary: Full regression (backend pytest + frontend Playwright) of all features shipped today: Contact & Support settings, Signup Bonus wallet card + freeze + admin backfill, secure password reset with OTP + generic responses + wrong-OTP lockout, session revocation via /security/logout-all, admin devices list + remove, employee 403 on admin/contact. All 13 backend tests PASS and all frontend spot checks PASS. Production data preserved: contact values reverted (all mobiles 6376541191, radhikatradersofficial@gmail.com, bhatiharish276@gmail.com); signup_bonus setting restored to 20 enabled=true; admin password NEVER changed; pwd_reset_otps and otp_locks cleaned for admin email after wrong-OTP lock test.
critical_code_review_comments: wallet-bonus-locked testid element remained present in DOM on /wallet even when signup bonus status is 'Credited' (observed for testcust). Minor: this testid should only render for the locked variant so tests can differentiate. Not a functional bug — the visible label correctly shows 'Signup Bonus · Credited'.
GET /api/contact/public exposes 4 fields (owner_email correctly excluded), matches spec. Cache-Control: no-store confirmed.
PUT /api/admin/contact: same-values submission returns 400 (rejects no-change) as required; invalid mobile/email rejected with 400/422; history & activity-log entries written.
POST /api/admin/signup-bonus/backfill is idempotent on 2nd run (locked=0, credited=0).
Signup-bonus amount frozen per user: after admin changed setting 20 -> 100, testcust wallet.signup_bonus.amount unchanged.

POST /api/auth/forgot-password: nonexistent email returns generic 200; wrong-portal for admin email returns generic 200 without sending; legitimate admin request returns {expires_in:300, resend_in:60} and immediate 2nd call returns 429 cooldown; 5 wrong OTPs return 400,400,400,400,429 (lock).
Session revocation: /security/logout-all invalidates both old tokens (A and B) and returns a fresh working token — token_version bump verified via /auth/me 401 on old tokens.
Admin devices: GET /security/status returns devices list with fingerprints; DELETE /security/devices/{fp} returns 200 then 404 on repeat.
Employee (rahul.k) GET /api/admin/contact -> 403 and UI /admin/contact redirects away.
